references.text: A similar introductory formula where the Lord speaks to both Moses and Aaron together about laws of purity.
The same introductory formula is used when the Lord gives laws about leprosy to Moses and Aaron.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together about regulations concerning purity.
Refers to the Lord's speech to both Moses and Aaron as recipients of God's word.
A standard opening formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, which is consistent throughout the Torah.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron about purity regulations regarding the red heifer.
